description: This file defines the MediaContentObserver activity class for Android, which manages observing media content changes via ContentObserver, interacts with various jobs for media and photos, and handles permission requests.

classes.name: MediaContentObserver
classes.description: An Android activity that observes media content changes using ContentObserver, manages scheduling and canceling media/jobs, and handles permissions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up content observer, UI elements, and button click listeners for media and photos jobs.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles the result of permission request to access external storage, and schedules photo content job if permission is granted.

methods.name: updateButtons
methods.description: Enables or disables buttons based on whether media or photos jobs are scheduled.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Unregisters the content observer when the activity is destroyed.
